description: Text2SQL Golden 数据集：随 prompt / LangGraph / Vanna 演进做回归基线。CI 以此为门禁：命中率不得低于上一次基线。
schema_seed_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, category TEXT); CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, qty INTEGER, created_at TEXT); INSERT INTO products (id,name,price,category) VALUES (1,'iPhone 15',7999.0,'phone'),(2,'MacBook Pro',19999.0,'laptop'),(3,'AirPods',1299.0,'audio'); INSERT INTO orders (id,product_id,qty,created_at) VALUES (1,1,2,'2026-04-01'),(2,2,1,'2026-04-02'),(3,3,5,'2026-04-03');

cases.question: 列出所有商品名称和价格
价格最高的商品
cases.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: AirPods 卖出了几件？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.qty) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.id WHERE p.name = 'AirPods'

cases.question: 商品按价格从低到高排序
cases.reference_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC

cases.question: 手机类目的商品总共有几件
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'phone'

cases.question: 最便宜的商品是什么类目
cases.reference_sql: SELECT category FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 查询每个类目的商品数量
cases.reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

cases.question: 销量最高的商品的名称
cases.reference_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN orders o ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(o.qty) DESC LIMIT 1
